items.title: National Additive Manufacturing Centre-West (NAMCW)
items.description: Additive Manufacturing & 3D Prototyping. Industry Partner: Stratasys & Ministry of Electronics and IT. A prestigious national center focusing on advanced 3D printing and additive manufacturing technologies to support engineering prototyping.

items.title: Japan India Institute of Manufacturing (JIIM)
items.description: Automobile Assembly & Japanese Shop-Floor Practices. Industry Partner: Maruti Suzuki India Limited & Government of Japan. Established under a collaboration between the Governments of India and Japan, featuring a fully functional automobile assembly training line in a university set-up.

items.title: GUNI-Bosch Rexroth Centre for Automation Technology
items.description: Industrial Automation, Pneumatics & Hydraulics. Industry Partner: Bosch Rexroth & Bosch Foundation. A state-of-the-art facility featuring industrial-grade hardware in pneumatics, hydraulics, mechatronics, and electrical automation systems.

items.title: Centre of Advanced Technology for Next-Generation Networks (5G & Beyond)
items.description: 5G Architecture, IoT & Next-Gen Wireless Systems. Industry Partner: eInfochips & local telecom consortia. Focuses on network software design, network security protocols, IoT integration, and wireless communication standards.

items.title: AAK-FICSI-GUNI Centre of Excellence for Choco Bakery
items.description: Food Processing Technology & Professional Baking Systems. Industry Partner: AAK India & Food Industry Capacity & Skill Initiative (FICSI). An advanced culinary and food technology center targeting training, product development, and skill certification in chocolate and baking technology.

items.title: GUNI - Centre for Bharatiya Knowledge System & Ancient Wisdom (BKS & AW)
items.description: Traditional Knowledge, Philosophy & Sanskrit Studies. Industry Partner: Academic & Spiritual Institutions. Curates, preserves, and disseminates traditional Indian science, architecture, philosophy, and historical structures.

data.title: What People Say
data.subtitle: Perspectives from colleagues, faculty, and students

body: Led the university through a decade of unparalleled growth, bridging the industry-academia gap through strategic alliances and world-class infrastructure.
Over two decades, he has built, restructured, and scaled world-class learning centers in India, setting academic standards that continue to yield talent and research breakthroughs.

quote.text: The measure of leadership is not the positions held, but the lives transformed, the institutions strengthened, and the future possibilities unlocked for generations to come.
